name: E3 Saxo Classic ME
story: A six-rider breakaway went clear after the start. On the first passage of the Karnemelkbeekstraat a strong move formed from the peloton. On the Taaienberg, Jasper Stuyven’s acceleration stretched the peloton before Tim van Dijke attacked, with Mathieu van der Poel the only rider able to follow. Van der Poel then went clear on the Boigneberg, bridged to the leaders on the Kapelberg and dropped them for good on the Paterberg with 42 km to go. He looked set for a comfortable solo win, but the chasers came back rapidly in the closing kilometres. Van der Poel just held on, ahead of Per Strand Hagenes and Florian Vermeersch.
